certifications.name: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
certifications.description: Foundational knowledge of cloud concepts and core Azure services: architecture, compute, networking, storage, identity and security, cost management, governance and monitoring.
certifications.audience: People starting with cloud computing, including non-technical roles, who want to show foundational knowledge of cloud concepts and Microsoft Azure.
recommendedPrerequisites: No prerequisites are required. General IT familiarity is helpful.
certifications.verificationNotes: Verified on the official certification page and study guide. No retirement date is announced.

certifications.name: Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals
certifications.description: Foundational AI concepts and responsible AI, plus building AI solutions with Microsoft Foundry: generative AI apps and agents, text and speech, computer vision and image generation, and information extraction.
certifications.audience: People at the beginning of an AI solution development career. The official study guide expects conceptual knowledge of Azure AI, familiarity with Azure resources and knowledge of Python syntax.
recommendedPrerequisites: Basic Python syntax and programming techniques (as stated in the official study guide)
Familiarity with Azure resources (AZ-900 is a good starting point)
certifications.verificationNotes: AI-901 replaced AI-900, which retired on June 30, 2026 (official AI-900 exam page). The study guide notes that the exam may include commonly used preview features.

tr.name: Microsoft Azure Yapay Zekâ Temelleri

tr.audience: Yapay zekâ çözümü geliştirme kariyerinin başında olan kişiler. Resmî çalışma kılavuzu, Azure yapay zekâ hakkında kavramsal bilgi, Azure kaynaklarına aşinalık ve Python sözdizimi bilgisi bekler.
